# Housekeeping: wasm-gate-corpus

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `tools/wasm-gate-corpus` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `tools/wasm-gate-corpus` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

## Sol brief approval and decision record

Approved 2026-10-01 by root Sol within the user's crate-by-crate housekeeping request. Attempt 1 is authorized with the frozen scope/gates above. Owner questions are collected for the final report; routine reversible cleanup proceeds autonomously. Scope is this package's housekeeping, not completion of pre-existing feature/bug issues.

## Attempt evidence

### Attempt 1 — complete shared-corpus audit

Worker B (GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh) read all 1,802 pre-change Rust lines, all 114 generated pin-table lines and the manifest, plus the native G5/G6 owners, guest/report adapters and relevant script/CI/ruling boundaries. Current #172 (unfused FMA), #952 (new resident-fold case), #1019 (AArch64 compressor release defect), #1069 (multiband cut), R7 and the single-owner corpus ruling remain separate. Root approved the bounded proposal, committed its only product path as `66461322`, integrated/pushed through `89beee59`, and independently reviewed the complete diff. Product changes stopped at that checkpoint.

Five-axis findings:

- **Repetition/LoC:** one private ordered little-endian `u32` hashing loop now serves nine delegated word wrappers, borrowed lane-major samples and builtin values. The `u64` math hash remains separate. Wrapper output ownership/lifetime, every `run_case`, word count/order and SHA update order are preserved; no intermediate collection was added. Current FMA comments now describe the existing two-rounding contract and the native fused nonvacuity reference, retaining the midpoint family's historical provenance. Net Rust **−41 lines** (46 added/87 removed).
- **Test value:** this package has no local test functions; its shared computations are exercised by the single G5 native owner and the actual Wasm guest. All pin/scenario tables and every owning behavioral test remain. No test, generator or case was added, rewritten or deleted, so no deletion requires a replacement gate. Unique family purposes are recorded below.
- **Copies/ownership:** four element-wise lane scratch vectors and the sample-peak output vector are now `[f32; LANES]` arrays: five tiny allocation sites removed. Every changed `Lane::load/store` receives the same `[..width]` slice length as before, preserving bounds as well as values; the unused suffix is never consumed. Private dispatch instantiates only widths 1/4/8, bounded by `LANES = 8`. Large corpus outputs, independent source/result storage, AoSoA gather/scatter and Sum2's disjoint output/copy remain necessary for the existing APIs and layout-independent hash order. No ownership copy inside DSP was changed.
- **Micro SIMD:** the audited lane implementations read/write exactly WIDTH prefix values; the changed code still calls the same lane arithmetic and meter kernels in the same order. No new SIMD algorithm or arithmetic is justified for corpus generation or SHA packing. The actual SIMD128 guest's existing f64/meter probe censuses confirmed vector promotion/mul/add and the meter's vector peak/count operations with no scalar substitutions. These are lowering facts, not speed, stack or spill claims for the hashing helper.
- **Data structures:** bounded lane scratch now uses arrays; the larger patterns, random streams and delegated output vectors remain heap buffers to avoid large fixed stack storage. The small frozen kernel/signal/case tables and ordered case decoder already preserve deterministic indices without a lookup structure. F64 pools, carried energies and meter schedules retain their exact generation/traversal/padding order. `LANES` is a fixed test corpus size, not a product track-count limit.

Current corpus-family purposes (all retained):

- **13 kernels × four signals:** low/high/band/bell SVF outputs, active/idle coefficient ramps, one-pole, gain/gain-mix, gain ramp, Sum2/SumInto and matrix exercise each real kernel at every available width. Seeded independent noise, impulse, DC and subnormal input/state discriminate lane leaks, recurrence/mix order, flush behavior and ramp-end snaps. The idle-ramped SVF deliberately equals the plain low-pass counterpart; the impulse gain ramp deliberately remains nonzero.
- **Three element-wise families:** frozen FMA witness/midpoint/cancellation operands distinguish two-rounding multiply/add from fused evaluation; exp2/log2 anchors and random ranges reach clamp rails and exponent boundaries. **Sample-peak family:** hostile raw words and ragged block/window prefixes exercise sanitization, running-peak carry/reset and target-specific D8 max lowering, with only finite sanitized output hashed.
- **Delegated math/runtime:** M3's scalar numerical word stream and D1's lane-generic level/dB/follower composition are replayed against their owning pins. **Transient shaper:** whole follower/dB/ramp/identity composition. **Delay:** scalar ring/delay kernel multiply/add sites. **Multiband:** LR splitting/all-pass, state flush, dB chain, smoothing and detector link. **Soft clip:** half-band/shaper/dry-wet composition. **Parametric EQ:** settled/ramped cascade and subnormal integrators. **Gate/expander:** causal detection/hysteresis, hold/ballistics, gain, flush and live ramp. **Builtins:** input sanitation/counters, trim/filter/fader/mute/matrix chain, including appended cases. **Limiter:** Annex-2 detector, window/lookahead schedules, grid ramp and release flush. **Compressor:** per-lane detector/knee/ballistics/mix and mid-block automation. All use the current owners' pin constants, not copied historical tables.
- **Unpinned raw-word counts:** min/max tests every ordered hostile pair, including NaN payloads and both zeros; f64 widening uses an independent integer oracle, add/mul use directed ties plus random pairs, and energy compares each step of independent chains. Full meter compares peak/clip/sanitize counts and serial f64 energy against an independent scalar loop across hostile/tone streams, ragged frames and carried blocks. Their black-box barriers, NaN comparison rules and padding remain unchanged; digest agreement alone cannot replace them.

Retained owning behavioral purposes:

- `g5_native_digests_match_pins`: every current case/available width matches the sole shared pins and all three raw-word mismatch counts are zero.
- `g5_lane_corpus_is_finite`: a non-finite local lane output cannot silently enter a digest; output cardinality stays exact.
- `g5_case_digests_are_distinct`: an accidental duplicate scenario cannot hide behind corpus size, with the specified idle-SVF pair exempted.
- `g5_idle_ramped_svf_equals_the_plain_svf`: an idle coefficient ramp cannot change the defined plain-filter computation.
- `g5_fma_case_is_unfused_and_the_case_is_not_vacuous`: every width agrees with explicit multiply/add while a genuinely fused native reference differs.
- `g5_delegated_cases_use_the_owning_crates_pins`: replay must cover the actual owning tables/names/widths and preserve the appended builtin case layout.
- `g5_no_case_is_vacuously_zero`: only the specified one-pole flush case may collapse to all positive zeros; every other local scenario reaches live arithmetic.
- G6's `g6_full_wasm_gate_corpus_is_canonical_under_caller_ftz` and `g6_the_guard_is_an_identity_for_a_caller_who_never_set_ftz`: canonical guarded output matches pins under hostile caller FTZ/DAZ, a real unguarded control diverges, clear callers retain all words/order and caller control state is restored. These are separate environment defects, not repeated pin checks.

### Root adversarial verdict: PASS — attempt 1

Root Sol inspected the complete sole product diff, private width dispatch, original and current hash traversal/allocation lifetimes, actual seven native G5 behavioral owners, full family record and runtime/target/lint/policy logs. Flattening arrays retains lane-major order and each u32 is still little-endian before the identical SHA update. Nine wrapper buffers stay owned until their original wrapper return; the separate u64 math path is intact. Fixed scratch arrays are bounded by the only instantiated widths 1/4/8, and every changed load/store keeps its original width prefix. Generators, draws, output lengths, arithmetic expressions, delegated and generated pins, reports and feature surfaces are unchanged.

No test is new, rewritten or retired. The seven G5 owners retain distinct corpus/pin coverage, finite/cardinality, duplicate-case, idle-ramp, fused/unfused nonvacuity, delegation-layout and zero-output defects; G6 independently covers hostile caller FTZ and clean-caller identity/restoration. Actual release native 7+2 and Wasm 142 cases/250 comparisons/all mismatch counts zero discriminate an ordered-hash or scratch-prefix mistake without creating a mirror test. The existing Wasm SIMD census is actual lowering evidence, not a speed claim; AArch64 checks are correctly described as compiles. Required CI owns the additional arm64 execution gate.

The complete five-axis audit and unchanged single-owner corpus boundaries earn PASS. The five allocation sites are absent by construction; no measured performance gain, stack/spill claim, new harness, re-pin or algorithm change is claimed.
